clippings.speaker: John Huston
clippings.quote: No. I helped him. Knowing Bogart so well, and I saw Bogart as the role, as the part, and I was able to help him into it.
clippings.title: John Huston
clippings.context: TV interview transcript; Moyers asked whether Bogart disliked the Charlie Allnut role and had to be coaxed into it.

clippings.speaker: John Huston
clippings.quote: an ideal collaborator and companion...He's a joy to work with...his figure seemed to find its way into whatever I did.
clippings.title: The Big Idea
clippings.context: TCM's making-of article on The African Queen quotes Huston on Bogart; original source not given.

clippings.speaker: John Huston
clippings.quote: Both Bogie and I teased Katie unmercifully at the beginning. She thought we were rascals, scamps, rogues. We did everything we could to support this belief. We pretended to get roaring drunk.
clippings.title: Behind the Camera - The African Queen
clippings.context: TCM quotes Huston's 1980 autobiography An Open Book on how he and Bogart treated Katharine Hepburn on location.

clippings.speaker: John Huston
clippings.quote: The better I got to know him, the more I admired him. He was a very serious man. He took great pride in being an actor. There'll never be another Bogart.
clippings.title: Star of the Month: Humphrey Bogart
clippings.context: TCM profile quotes Huston speaking the night before Bogart's funeral in January 1957.

clippings.speaker: Humphrey Bogart
clippings.quote: I just want to pay a slight, as a matter of fact a very big tribute to Mr. John Huston and Miss Katharine Hepburn, because they helped me to be where I am now.
clippings.title: Humphrey Bogart Academy Awards Acceptance Speech
clippings.context: Bogart's Best Actor acceptance speech for The African Queen, directed by Huston.

clippings.speaker: Humphrey Bogart
clippings.quote: He's brilliant and unpredictable. Never dull. When I work with John, I think about acting. I don't worry about business.
clippings.title: The Big Idea
clippings.context: TCM's making-of article quotes Bogart on why he trusted Huston enough to shoot in Africa; original source not given.

clippings.speaker: Humphrey Bogart
clippings.quote: John wanted everything perfect. If he saw a nearby mountain that could serve for photographic purposes, that mountain was not good; too easy to reach.
clippings.film: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
clippings.title: Trivia & Fun Facts About THE TREASURE OF THE SIERRA MADRE
clippings.context: TCM says Bogart told an unnamed interviewer this about Huston's exacting location choices.

notes: Bogart died in 1957, so his side is thin: only the Oscar speech is primary; the rest come via TCM articles that don't name original sources. Huston's 1957 eulogy only survives online in fragments (NBC New York, quote sites), so it was skipped.
